scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0096; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “I set it here.” and “I set the book there.” are plausible short A1 utterances in the stated scene.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently preserves the bounded lesson meaning of set.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical target is practiced inside familiar short sentence frames.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors separate the intended answer from the transfer response and unrelated familiar language.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The character pair has a concrete reason to exchange both target utterances.

difficultyFit.evidence: The lesson stays at short early-A1 utterance length and introduces one bounded lexical target.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: set is repeated through recognition, guided response, transfer and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the communicative context while preserving the target sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities and outcome align on the same bounded target.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; learner-experience confidence is intentionally limited.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review covers only the bounded A1 target sense.
Generated audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: Persian copy preserves the selected meaning.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval.
Character/story rotation is spaced by 5 Lessons and the learner role/story beat is varied.
